title: 5d-9: MCP constraint tools
description:
## Parent

sutra/68 — 5d PRD: constraint system + DD integration

## What to build

MCP tool actions for constraint management. Thin translation layer over the library API, following existing patterns in `src/tools/conventions.rs`. Actions: `list` (all constraints with metadata), `violations` (current DD violations), `waive` (create waiver with rationale), `unwaive` (revoke waiver).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `list` action
- [ ] `violations` action
- [ ] `waive` action
- [ ] `unwaive` action
- [ ] Follows existing MCP tool patterns

## Blocked by

- sutra/71 — 5d-3: DD forbidden pairs maintained view
- sutra/73 — 5d-5: constraint waivers (DB)

acceptance_criteria.text: MCP tool action: list — returns all constraints with kind, severity, name, provenance, scope, resolution status
MCP tool action: violations — returns current constraint violations from DD maintained view
MCP tool action: waive — creates a constraint waiver with required rationale
MCP tool action: unwaive — revokes a constraint waiver
Tool follows existing MCP tool patterns (thin translation layer over library API)
JSON output matches existing tool conventions
